updates.rationale: The accepted paired-output curvature result supplies a rigorous, verifier-backed restriction |c_in|<7/50 for every two-letter Marton gain candidate. This removes part of the covariance search domain and the work of deriving and certifying that pruning lemma, while substantial full-support candidate analysis and gain-or-no-gain resolution remain. The evidence does not foreclose the search branch, so its conditional incidence is unchanged.
